question: What scope of fashioned auspicious and inauspicious things warrants homage to the goddess?
premises: Fashioned things are located in the goddess's hand and skull.
These fashioned things include both auspicious and inauspicious kinds.
The goddess encompasses this totality of fashioned things.
inference: Therefore the goddess is worthy of bowing as the holder of all fashioned auspicious and inauspicious things.
uncertainties: The precise symbolic relation between hand and skull as loci of fashioned things is not explicit.
plain_english: I bow to her, in whose hand and skull are fashioned all things, both auspicious and inauspicious.
